repos.name: wuyoscar/Internal-Safety-Collapse
repos.description: [NeurIPS 2026] Safety failures in coding agents and frontier LLMs. Reproducible workspaces for studying when AI agents generate unsafe data during task completion.
repos.one_liner: A research framework for analyzing safety failures and security vulnerabilities in autonomous coding agents and frontier LLMs.
bullets: Built on Python with reproducible workspace environments for controlled testing.
Focuses on identifying 'safety collapse' where agents generate unsafe or malicious code during task execution.
Provides a benchmarking suite for evaluating the robustness of AI agents against adversarial prompts.
Essential for developers and security researchers building enterprise-grade agentic workflows.
repos.img_alt: The same unfinished program in earlier chatbots, a frontier chatbot, and a coding agent
repos.img2_alt: TVD task execution and data files, compared with prompt attacks and safety classifiers

repos.name: agentsea/nautilo
repos.description: AI goes multiplayer. A self-hosted workspace for people and machine people. Create, code, and work together across desktop, mobile, and web. Open source. MIT licensed.
repos.one_liner: A multi-user, self-hosted workspace designed for collaborative interaction between humans and AI agents.
bullets: TypeScript-based architecture supporting cross-platform access across desktop, mobile, and web.
Enables shared environments where AI agents and human users can co-edit and interact in real-time.
Focuses on agentic infrastructure, providing a persistent workspace for long-running autonomous tasks.
Ideal for teams looking to integrate AI agents into their daily collaborative development or operational pipelines.
repos.img_alt: Elias and Lyra working together in Writer, with changes ready to review. Open the illustrated local setup guide.
repos.img2_alt: Keep the future open. The open, organization-level harness for everyone needs your support. Support Nautilo on GitHub Sponsors.

repos.name: alesha-pro/llm.asm
repos.description: Qwen3-0.6B inference (12 KB), bare-metal bootable OS (22 KB), and from-scratch Mini-GPT trainer with live Braille TUI (32 KB) in 100% pure x86-64 NASM assembly. Zero C, zero libc, zero dependencies.
repos.one_liner: A bare-metal, dependency-free implementation of LLM inference and training written entirely in x86-64 NASM assembly.
bullets: Zero-dependency stack: no C, no libc, and no external libraries, running directly on hardware.
Includes a 12 KB Qwen3-0.6B inference engine and a 32 KB Mini-GPT trainer.
Demonstrates extreme optimization techniques for running AI models on minimal infrastructure.
Highly notable for low-level systems engineering and understanding the fundamental compute requirements of LLMs.
repos.img2_alt: Running on Real Proxmox VE VM (0 GB Disk, Intel Xeon KVM)

repos.name: opensetlabs/openset-llm
repos.description: Fast local LLM inference on plain CPUs. No GPU, 8 GB of RAM. OpenAI-compatible server.
repos.one_liner: A high-performance local LLM inference server optimized for standard CPUs without requiring dedicated GPU hardware.
bullets: C++ backend optimized for CPU-only execution, requiring only 8 GB of RAM.
Provides an OpenAI-compatible API, allowing seamless integration with existing LLM-based applications.
Lowers the barrier to entry for deploying private, local AI infrastructure in resource-constrained environments.
Useful for fintech or enterprise applications requiring data privacy and local execution without expensive hardware.

repos.name: petergyang/video-explainer
repos.description: Turn any topic, doc, codebase, or URL into a crisp 1-minute explainer video in Motion, Illustrated, or 3D style
repos.one_liner: An automated tool that converts complex documentation, codebases, or URLs into concise, high-quality explainer videos.
bullets: Python-based pipeline that integrates LLM content synthesis with automated video generation.
Supports multiple visual styles including Motion, Illustrated, and 3D rendering.
Automates the creation of technical documentation and product walkthroughs for developers and stakeholders.
Streamlines the communication of complex technical concepts into digestible visual formats.
